question:
Assertion (A): Every vertex (corner point) of the feasible region is a feasible solution of the LPP.

Reason (R): Feasible solutions are those points which do not satisfy all the constraints of the LPP.
explanation:
Assertion (A) is true because corner points, being on the boundary of the feasible region, satisfy all constraints.

Reason (R) is false because feasible solutions do satisfy all constraints.

options.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.
